visual_elements.description: Equation panel: rounded rectangle, white fill, dark-red ~2.5pt border, corner radius ~15px. Contents left to right: (a) pale pink-lavender rounded pill containing four small white circles with red borders labeled X_21, X_22, X_23, X_24 (black bold, subscripts); (b) red bold 'X_2' (subscript 2) below the pill, tiny red '1xd' at the pill's lower right; (c) red bold 'W_Q' (subscript Q) below X_2; (d) the 4x4 matrix (separate element); (e) tiny red 'dxd' at the matrix bottom-right; (f) red bold '=' sign; (g) vertical 4x1 output vector of four pink rounded cells with dark-maroon text X_Q21, X_Q22, X_Q23, X_Q24.

4x4 matrix of ~38x42px cells, pale-yellow fill, 1pt orange borders. Cell texts (bold, subscripted) with font colors - Row 1: W_11 (blue), W_21 (magenta), W_31 (orange), W_41 (green). Row 2: W_12, W_22, W_32, W_42 (all magenta/purple). Row 3: W_13, W_23, W_33, W_43 (all orange). Row 4: W_14, W_24, W_34, W_44 (all green). Subscript convention: first digit = input index (varies across columns), second digit = output index (varies down rows).

Large elbow/bent block arrow, white fill, dark-red ~2.5pt outline. Horizontal tail segment directly below the subtitle; shaft bends 90 degrees downward and terminates in a broad triangular arrowhead pointing straight down at the network panel.

Fully-connected layer diagram inside a blue-bordered rounded rectangle (no fill). TOP ROW (outputs): four ~44px circles, white fill, blue 2pt borders, black bold subscripted labels X_Q21, X_Q22, X_Q23, X_Q24 at x ~56%, 67.5%, 78.6%, 88.8% width, y ~52%; small colored arc marks hug the bottom edge of X_Q21 (red), X_Q22 (blue), X_Q24 (green). MIDDLE: light-gray rounded band (#D9D9D9, no border) spanning ~51%-93% width, ~56.5%-79% height, containing red bold 'W_Q' at its left edge plus weight labels: red W_11, W_12, W_13, W_14 stepping down-right; blue W_21, W_22, plus a second blue label read as W_21 (possibly W_23) [?]; green W_41, W_42, W_43, W_44 stepping down-right; a small dark-navy arrowhead sits mid-diagram (~72% width, ~64% height) on a blue line pointing down-left. BOTTOM ROW (inputs): four ~44px circles, gray fill #C0C0C0, red 2pt borders, black bold labels X_21, X_22, X_23, X_24 at the same x positions, y ~85.5%. CONNECTIONS: thin ~1pt lines from every input circle to every output circle (16 total) passing behind the gray band; lines from X_21 are red, from X_22 blue, from X_24 green; lines from X_23 are faint/unlabeled (no W_31-W_34 labels shown).
Slide-number badge: yellow circle ~36px diameter with black '32' centered.

imagery: No photographs, icons, or illustrations; all visuals are flat vector shapes (circles, rounded rectangles/pills, matrix grid cells, one block arrow, connector lines).
typography_notes: Entirely sans-serif (Arial/Calibri-like). Title ~22pt bold red; subtitle ~20pt bold italic blue; all math tokens (X, W) bold with numeric/letter subscripts (e.g., X_21, W_Q, X_Q21); dimension labels 1xd and dxd are tiny (~9pt) red; slide number plain black. No serif fonts, no all-caps, no numbered bullets; heavy reliance on subscript formatting and color-coded math text.
animation_state: No dimmed or ghosted placeholder elements; slide appears fully revealed. Caveat: the network diagram labels weights for inputs 1, 2 and 4 (red W_1x, blue W_2x, green W_4x) but shows no W_31-W_34 labels for input X_23 - either a deliberate omission or a paused build step.
recreation_brief:
1. Slide setup: 16:9 canvas, light-gray background #E8E8E8. Frame: a no-fill rectangle with 2.5pt dark-red #C00000 outline inset to ~4%-96% width and ~8%-98% height (bottom edge ~2% from the slide bottom).
2. Slide-number badge (top-right, ~91%-95% width, ~11%-17% height): yellow #FFD500 circle ~36px (~0.9in) diameter with centered black plain-weight '32' (Arial, ~14pt).
3. Equation panel (top-left, ~5.5%-48.5% width, ~13%-50% height): rounded rectangle, white #FFFFFF fill, corner radius ~15px, 2.5pt dark-red #C00000 border.
4. Input pill (left side inside the equation panel): pale pink-lavender #EFD9EF rounded pill holding four small white circles with thin (~1.5pt) red borders, labeled left-to-right X_21, X_22, X_23, X_24 (black bold, subscripted).
5. Pill captions: red bold 'X_2' (subscript 2, ~18pt) below the pill; tiny red '1xd' (~9pt) at the pill's lower right; red bold 'W_Q' (subscript Q) below 'X_2'.
6. Weight matrix (inside the equation panel, right of the pill, ~23%-39% width, ~16%-47.5% height): 4x4 grid of ~38x42px (~0.4in) cells, pale-yellow #FDF3C0 fill, 1pt orange #E0A048 borders. Bold subscripted cell text colored per row - Row 1: W_11 #2020C0, W_21 #B020B0, W_31 #E07020, W_41 #1A8A1A; Row 2: W_12, W_22, W_32, W_42 all #B020B0; Row 3: W_13, W_23, W_33, W_43 all #E07020; Row 4: W_14, W_24, W_34, W_44 all #1A8A1A. Add tiny red 'dxd' (~9pt) at the matrix bottom-right.
7. Equals sign: red bold '=' (~20pt) to the right of the matrix.
8. Output vector (right of the '='): vertical 4x1 stack of four pink #F9C9D4 rounded cells with dark-maroon #8B1A1A bold text X_Q21, X_Q22, X_Q23, X_Q24 (top to bottom).
9. Title block (top-right-center, ~60%-87% width, ~21%-32% height): 'Linear Transformation' in bold red #CC0000 ~22pt centered at ~73.5% width, ~26% height; directly below on the same center axis, '(= Fully connected Layer)' in bold italic blue #2020C0 ~20pt.
10. Elbow block arrow (center, ~50.5%-60% width, ~26.5%-44.5% height): white fill, 2.5pt dark-red #C00000 outline; horizontal tail directly below the subtitle, shaft bending 90 degrees downward, broad triangular arrowhead pointing straight down at the network panel.
11. Network panel (bottom-right, ~50%-94.5% width, ~45.5%-93.5% height): rounded rectangle, no fill, 2.5pt blue #2020C0 border.
12. Output circles (top row inside the network panel, y ~52%): four ~44px (~0.45in) circles, white fill, 2pt blue #2020C0 borders, black bold subscripted labels X_Q21, X_Q22, X_Q23, X_Q24 at x ~56%, 67.5%, 78.6%, 88.8% width. Add small arc marks hugging the bottom edge of X_Q21 (red #C00000), X_Q22 (blue #2020C0), and X_Q24 (green #1A8A1A).
13. Gray weight band (middle of the network panel, ~51%-93% width, ~56.5%-79% height): rounded rectangle, #D9D9D9 fill, no border. Place red bold 'W_Q' (subscript Q) at its left edge, then bold subscripted weight labels stepping down-right: red #C00000 W_11, W_12, W_13, W_14; blue #2020C0 W_21, W_22, plus a third blue label read as W_21, possibly W_23 [?]; green #1A8A1A W_41, W_42, W_43, W_44. Do not add W_31-W_34 labels (none appear on the slide).
14. Input circles (bottom row, y ~85.5%): four ~44px (~0.45in) circles, gray #C0C0C0 fill, 2pt red #C00000 borders, black bold subscripted labels X_21, X_22, X_23, X_24 at the same x positions as the output circles.
15. Connections: 16 thin ~1pt lines, one from every input circle to every output circle, sent behind the gray band - red #C00000 lines from X_21, blue #2020C0 from X_22, green #1A8A1A from X_24, and faint low-contrast lines from X_23 (color unspecified in source; no labels). Add a small dark-navy arrowhead on a blue line at ~72% width, ~64% height, pointing down-left.
16. Typography: Arial/Calibri-like sans-serif throughout; apply subscript formatting to every numeric/letter subscript (X_2, W_Q, X_21..X_24, X_Q21..X_Q24, W_11..W_44); keep red the dominant accent, blue secondary, yellow only on the badge.
